<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
widen_to_float32(arr: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.weights`](/api/evoxc-hf/weights/)

Apply the `evoxc_hf` checkpoint dtype policy to one tensor.

`float16` is widened to `float32` (a copying conversion, exact — every
float16 value is representable in float32); every other dtype is returned
unchanged. bfloat16 never exists as a numpy dtype — both readers widen it
at parse time (see `_bf16_words_to_float32`) — so there is nothing to
convert here.
